announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: Northern Electric PLC has released its half-year financial report. This follows the AGM results in June and a dividend declaration in August.

announcements.headline: Dividend Declaration
announcements.insight: A dividend declaration follows the AGM results. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for payment details.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the outcome of the Annual General Meeting. This result confirms the decisions made by the members during the meeting.
